anteriores.texto: Entre os filhos de Rúben, os gaditas e a meia tribo de Manassés havia guerreiros que carregavam escudo e espada, manejavam o arco e eram treinados para a guerra. Quarenta e quatro mil setecentos e sessenta estavam aptos para o serviço militar.
Eles fizeram guerra contra os hagarenos, Jetur, Nafis e Nodabe.

posteriores.texto: Eles tomaram como despojo o gado dos inimigos: cinquenta mil camelos, duzentas e cinquenta mil ovelhas, dois mil jumentos e cem mil pessoas.
Muitos caíram mortos, pois a guerra vinha de Deus; e eles habitaram no lugar dos inimigos até o exílio.

kjv.texto: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

vizinhos.19: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
vizinhos.21: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
